name: ToastPreview
description: A static toast for documentation. Same classes and layout, no timers.
signature: ({ tone, title, description, action }: { tone?: ToastTone; title: string; description?: string; action?: string; }): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: action
props.description: Label of the toast's action button, drawn inert; omit for a toast without an action.

props.name: description
props.description: Additional content describing the value, state, or consequence.

props.name: tone
props.description: The semantic tone. Use danger and warning for consequences and states.
